methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on 2026-06-13 (accessedAt); every figure is a real listed price, with quote-only/contact-sales tiers recorded as null monthlyUsd. Prices are per-seat/per-agent USD billed annually unless a flat per-account or ticket-based model is noted in the plan notes. Two providers (Zendesk, Zoho Desk) geo-redirected to EUR/INR storefronts, so their USD figures are taken from a corroborating price index (last verified Apr 2026) with the vendor pricing page kept as corroboration; minutes/calls/overage-per-minute fields are not applicable to this software category and are null throughout.

vendors.name: Zendesk
vendors.provenance: USD per-agent figures from costbench price index (last verified Apr 2026); vendor pricing page geo-redirected to EUR storefront and is kept as corroboration confirming identical plan structure.

plans.name: Support Team
plans.notes: $19 per agent/month billed annually. Email and ticketing system, ticket routing, pre-configured analytics dashboards, response templates, customer context, automations and triggers.

plans.name: Suite Team
plans.notes: $55 per agent/month billed annually. Adds AI agents, knowledge base, action builder, omnichannel routing, messaging and live chat, and voice.

plans.name: Suite Professional
plans.notes: $115 per agent/month billed annually. Adds app builder, writing tools, quick reports, admin copilot, skill-based routing, and IVR voice.

plans.name: Suite Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales (quote-only). The Suite Enterprise (Enterprise + Copilot) tier is no longer published as a fixed per-agent price; it is sales-led. Adds intelligent triage, automated assistance, generative AI for voice, sandbox, and custom agent roles.

vendors.name: Freshdesk
vendors.provenance: Plan names and per-agent USD prices read directly from the official Freshdesk pricing page on 2026-06-13.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free for up to 1-2 agents for 6 months, no credit card. Essential helpdesk: ticketing, knowledge base, pre-built reports, 24x5 support.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: $19 per agent/month billed annually. Ticketing, shared inbox, threads and tasks, customer portal, multilingual help desk, up to 5,000 collaborators.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $55 per agent/month billed annually (most popular). Adds customized support portals, custom objects, advanced ticketing, custom reporting, and multiple routing mechanisms.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $89 per agent/month billed annually. Adds audit logs, approval workflows, skills-based assignment, and additional enterprise security features.

vendors.name: Intercom
vendors.provenance: Plan names and per-seat monthly USD prices read directly from the official Intercom pricing page on 2026-06-13; only monthly per-seat prices are listed on the page.

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: $29 per seat/month. Fin AI Agent, Messenger, shared inbox and ticketing, pre-built reports, public help center. Fin charged separately at $0.99 per resolution.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: $85 per seat/month. Adds multiple team inboxes, workflow automation, round-robin assignment, private/multilingual help center, 20 free Lite seats.

plans.name: Expert
plans.notes: $132 per seat/month. Adds SSO and identity management, HIPAA support, SLAs, multibrand Messenger/help center, 50 free Lite seats.

vendors.name: Help Scout
vendors.provenance: Plan names, per-user USD prices, and HIPAA availability read directly from the official Help Scout pricing page on 2026-06-13.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free for up to 5 users, 100 contacts/month, 1 inbox, 1 Docs site. Basic email/chat, saved replies, tags, snooze. No HIPAA.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $25 per user/month billed annually, up to 25 users. Unlimited contacts, 2 inboxes, 2 Docs sites, live chat/Instagram/Messenger, basic workflows, one SLA policy, AI Inbox assistant. No HIPAA.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: $45 per user/month billed annually, up to 50 users. Adds WhatsApp, advanced workflows, two advanced SLA policies, unlimited AI Drafts, round-robin routing, Salesforce/Jira/HubSpot integrations. No HIPAA.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $75 per user/month billed annually, unlimited users (10 minimum). Unlimited workflows/SLA policies, multiple routing types, dedicated onboarding specialist, account manager. HIPAA available.

vendors.name: Gorgias
vendors.provenance: Plan names, monthly/annual prices, included ticket volumes, and overage rates read directly from the official Gorgias pricing page on 2026-06-13. Gorgias bills on ticket volume, not per seat.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $10/month flat for 50 tickets/month, overage $0.40/ticket. Basic helpdesk, omnichannel (email, chat, social), 150+ integrations, team management. Ticket-based billing.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: $60/month ($50/month billed annually) for 300 tickets/month, overage $40 per 100 tickets. Adds expanded integrations and support. Ticket-based billing.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $360/month ($300/month billed annually, recommended) for 2,000 tickets/month, overage $36 per 100 tickets. Adds revenue statistics, advanced routing, all channels. Ticket-based billing.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: $900/month ($750/month billed annually) for 5,000 tickets/month, overage $36 per 100 tickets. Adds dedicated email server and enhanced analytics. Ticket-based billing.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing (contact sales) for custom ticket volume, overage $32 per 100 tickets. All Advanced features plus dedicated support.

vendors.name: Zoho Desk
vendors.provenance: USD per-user figures from costbench price index (last verified Apr 2026, three independent sources); vendor pricing page geo-redirected to an INR storefront and is kept as corroboration confirming identical plan structure.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free for up to 3 agents. Basic email ticketing.

plans.name: Express
plans.notes: $7 per user/month billed annually. Email support, social channels, web forms, automatic ticket routing, workflows, custom domain.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $14 per user/month billed annually. Adds live chat, instant messaging (WhatsApp/Telegram/WeChat/Line), community forum, generative AI, knowledge base, self-service widget.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: $23 per user/month billed annually (most subscribed). Adds phone support, blueprints, multiple departments, round-robin assignment, multilingual help center, parent-child tickets.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $40 per user/month billed annually. Adds AI agents, Answer Bot, Zia AI, SalesIQ live chat, guided conversations, skill-based routing, multi-level IVR, multi-brand help centers, custom modules, sandbox.

vendors.name: Front
vendors.provenance: Plan names and per-seat USD prices (billed annually) read directly from the official Front pricing page on 2026-06-13.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $25 per seat/month billed annually, up to 10 seats. Shared inbox and ticketing, AI Topics, up to 10 automation rules, basic analytics, no-code public knowledge base.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: $65 per seat/month billed annually, up to 50 seats. Adds omnichannel (email, SMS, social), macros, up to 20 automation rules, advanced analytics, multiple workspaces with SSO and SCIM.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $105 per seat/month. Adds smart rules, unlimited rules and macros, multi-language knowledge base, custom roles and permissions, and AI Copilot, QA and CSAT included.

vendors.name: LiveAgent
vendors.provenance: Plan names and per-agent USD prices (annual and monthly) read directly from the official LiveAgent pricing page on 2026-06-13.

plans.name: Small Business
plans.notes: $15 per agent/month billed annually ($19 monthly). Ticketing, live chat, knowledge base, customer portal, contact forms, automation rules, integrations, AI Answer Assistant, AI Chatbot.

plans.name: Medium Business
plans.notes: $29 per agent/month billed annually ($35 monthly). Adds call center and IVR, time rules, reports, proactive chat invitations, agent ratings, SLA.

plans.name: Large Business
plans.notes: $49 per agent/month billed annually ($59 monthly, most popular). Adds SSO, custom roles, time tracking, audit log, Facebook/Instagram/X/Viber/Telegram/WhatsApp channels.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $69 per agent/month billed annually ($85 monthly). Adds dedicated account manager, priority support, assisted channel integration, custom billing, service review calls.

vendors.name: Tidio
vendors.provenance: Plan names and prices read directly from the official Tidio pricing page on 2026-06-13. Tidio bills flat per account on conversation volume, not per seat.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free per account. 50 billable conversations/month, 10 seats, basic live chat and ticketing.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $24.17/month flat per account ($290/year). 100 billable conversations/month, 10 seats, 50 Lyro AI conversations one-off, live chat and ticketing, basic analytics, multilanguage.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: From $49.17/month flat per account ($590/year, popular). From 250 billable conversations/month (customizable to 2,000), 10 seats, advanced analytics, auto chat assignment, macros, user permissions.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: From $749/month flat per account with custom conversation and seat limits. Departments, multiproject support, custom branding, ticketing automations, dedicated success manager, OpenAPI.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Custom pricing (contact sales). Custom conversation volume, from 3,000 Lyro AI conversations, guaranteed 50% Lyro AI resolution rate, pay-per-resolution billing, managed service, compliance and SSO.
